name: How long does it take to detect and repair a slab leak?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to detect and repair a slab leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Slab leak detection can typically take a few hours, depending on the leak's complexity and location. The repair duration varies significantly based on the chosen method; a spot repair might take one to two days, while a re-pipe could extend to several days. We prioritize efficient service to minimize disruption to your Summerlin or North Las Vegas home and keep you informed throughout the entire process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Detection usually takes a few hours, while repair can range from one day for a spot repair to several days for a re-pipe.
